recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if the work group wants a new current change to StructureDefinition/profile terminology; do not treat the historical separate ExtensionDefinition/Profile wording as a missing current-source fix.
issue_request: FHIR-3647 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 change request to split the monolithic Profile packaging resource so structures and extension definitions were separately addressable, shared element content moved to ElementDefinition, and packaging could occur through other mechanisms.
initial_application: Jira records application in SVN revisions 3310 through 3313, 3325, 3353, and 3416. Matching git-svn commits split Profile, pulled out extension definitions, adjusted extension rendering, and collapsed Profile/Structure, followed by a later refactor that merged Profile and ExtensionDefinition into StructureDefinition.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini has active StructureDefinition and SearchParameter resources, an ElementDefinition datatype page, and ExtensionDefinition under removed resources. StructureDefinition now describes resources, datatypes, extensions, and constraints; ElementDefinition captures element constraints; SearchParameter is its own canonical resource. No Zulip or Confluence search evidence contradicted this.
reconciliation: No source files were changed because the current build already satisfies the issue family after later refactoring. Adding separate ExtensionDefinition/Profile resource wording would be stale and redundant.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-3647 comments explicitly put SearchCriteria/SearchParameter handling in this separate issue; current source has SearchParameter as an active independent resource.
The history page groups FHIR-3498 with FHIR-3647 for structure/extension reference ambiguity, helping explain the later StructureDefinition model.
